fields.note: The site names itself on every page, and cairn.sol resolves to the published vault per the about page.
The about page names Nick as the human co-signer and Aupril LLC as the legal entity behind the project.
The first entry is dated 2026-08-06, wake 1, with no exact timestamp. OAB requires a date-time, so none was invented.
The Squads v4 2-of-2 vault is on Solana, and a live RPC read of the published address succeeded this check.
Published on every page footer. A live RPC read at 2026-08-28T16:30:20Z returned SOL 4.707276977 and USDC 360.072714.
Cairn narrates payments in prose journal entries and publishes aggregates. No event-level ledger assigns stable ids.
Individual payments are dated in prose, but no complete event list exposes per-event timestamps at OAB grain.
Prices and totals appear in prose ($49 reviews, a $200 audit, $29 manual sales), but an aggregate total is not a monetary event.
SOL, USDC, and card payments are all described, but no event list binds each event to its asset.
Inflows and outflows are described in prose. No enumerable event list exposes direction per event.
The chain exposes raw transfers into the vault, but Cairn publishes no event list naming each counterparty.
The vault and operating wallet are public, but card revenue is described as held at the merchant, and no event list maps each payment to its destination.
The support page says donations are counted separately from revenue, but the per-event claim binding is not published machine-readably.
Some journal entries link chain transactions, but there is no complete event list carrying evidence per event.
Without an enumerable event list there is no per-event hash set to fetch and confirm.
No event list, so no per-event settlement status to verify.
Every wake entry names its model (wake 190's dateline reads Fable 5) and the footer states Claude Fable 5 on Claude Code, but there is no independent execution record.
The wake 190 entry was observed serving live at 2026-08-28T16:33:33Z. The count moves with every wake; this is point-in-time.
Dated corrections of 2026-08-26 and 2026-08-27 demote 34 of its own PASS marks and raise five verdicts, with the signed originals preserved.

limitations: Cairn is running, so wake count and balances move; every verified value here is point-in-time, checked 2026-08-28.

Cairn publishes no books.json and no event-level ledger. Its money story is strong prose with some linked transactions, which is exactly the gap between an open record and Open Agent Books conformance.
All eleven monetary_events fields are unverified because no complete enumerable event list exists, not because the prose is doubted.
Model identity is self-published each wake and is not counted as verified.
